lessonPractice.title: 官网页头在桌面放品牌、五个导航、搜索和登录，到了手机后已经挤成两行。怎样调整？

options.label: 保留品牌和关键操作，把次要导航收进可关闭的移动菜单
options.feedback: 页头继续承担身份和主要入口，移动端按优先级收纳能避免把每个元素强行压小。

options.label: 继续保留全部入口，并缩小字体、间距和按钮高度直到一行
options.feedback: 内容虽然挤回一行，却会降低阅读和点击准确性，也没有建立移动端信息优先级。

options.label: 隐藏品牌和首页入口，只保留导航、搜索与登录
options.feedback: 用户会失去当前网站身份和返回首页的稳定入口，页头的基本职责没有完成。

en.title: A desktop header contains brand, five navigation items, search, and login, but wraps to two lines on mobile. How should it adapt?

options.label: Keep brand and the key action, and move secondary navigation into a dismissible mobile menu
options.feedback: The header preserves identity and primary access, while prioritization avoids shrinking every control beyond usability.

options.label: Keep every entry and reduce type, gaps, and button height until they fit one line
options.feedback: It may fit, but readability and click accuracy decline, and no mobile information priority is established.

options.label: Hide the brand and home entry while keeping navigation, search, and login
options.feedback: Users lose the site identity and stable home path, leaving a basic header responsibility unmet.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请按优先级重排页头：桌面保留品牌、主要导航、搜索和登录；手机保留品牌与关键操作，其余进入可打开、可关闭的菜单。验证菜单焦点、当前页状态和长中文导航不会挤压布局。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Prioritize the header: keep brand, primary navigation, search, and login on desktop; retain brand and the key action on mobile and move the rest into a dismissible menu. Verify focus, current-page state, and long labels.

use.t: Use a page header when the brand, primary navigation, and account controls need to stay together at the top.
Documentation and ecommerce sites often need Search in the header.
Design the mobile header separately: keep the brand and primary actions, and move secondary links into a menu.
Put temporary announcements above the header, and keep their purpose distinct from navigation.

dont.t: Cram every navigation link and action into the header, making important actions hard to find.
Make a fixed header so tall that it obscures content while the user scrolls.
Omit both a brand marker and a link home, leaving users unsure which site they are on.
Treat the page header and {c:navbar} as the same thing. Distinguish them by the top-level container and their navigation role.
